The Center’s mission is to turn frailty measurement into action: develop rigorous approaches to assess frailty, embed them into clinical care and health systems, implement and evaluate interventions, and disseminate what works to help older adults maintain independence and quality of life. * Create analytic cohorts according to the analysis protocol prepared by the investigators (a typical cohort includes an index event [e.g., drug prescribing or surgical procedure] and measurement of baseline covariates and outcome variables [e.g., time to event, count of health care utilization, and cost]).

* Help orient and train new team members and research assistants in team workflows and RWD programming.
* Assist investigators with scientific presentations, manuscripts, and grant applications by providing sample size counts and preparing tables and figures from the analysis.
